{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Convert revenue from string to float, removing commas
data['revenue'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Remove QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
data_clean = data[data['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Remove refunded orders — only 'completed' should be in the population
population = data_clean[data_clean['status'] == 'completed']

# Final population size
final_population_size = len(population)
print(f"Final population size: {final_population_size}")

# Compute conversion rates
email_rate = population[population['channel'] == 'email']['converted'].mean()
paid_search_rate = population[population['channel'] == 'paid_search']['converted'].mean()
difference = email_rate - paid_search_rate

print(f"Conversion rate (email): {email_rate:.4f}")
print(f"Conversion rate (paid_search): {paid_search_rate:.4f}")
print(f"Difference (email - paid_search): {difference:.4f}")"}
